summary: Kaniksu NF crow's nest on Two Tail Peak, Boundary County, from the 1930s; recorded as abandoned and gone. Sources are thin and no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. Idaho Fire Lookouts says abandoned, not destroyed. No source describes what remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts describes the site as a hike-in

events.note: Crow's nest, dated only to the 1930s. 1930 is a placeholder for the start of that decade, not a documented date; no built year is recorded.

corrections.why: The FFLA listing gives 48.67157 -116.18158. Our record's idaho_fl value differs from the other values we hold for this site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts says Abandoned; the FFLA listing says Gone. The story says it was abandoned and is listed as gone. No source gives a date for its removal.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: every source gives a one-line history (1930s crow's nest, abandoned), with no staff, fire or construction detail. Coordinates conflict (see corrections); the FFLA listing is the only source we read with coordinates. Story length is short because the evidence is short. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page marks it Hike-In Abandoned and gives 4,032 ft.
